best_match.fbbt_definition: Type I (principal) cell of the adult Malpighian tubule. These are found throughout the tubule and outnumber other cell types overall (Singh et al., 2007). They transport cations and organic solutes (Singh et al., 2007).

justification: The authors annotated this type with FBbt:00005735 'adult Malpighian tubule principal cell', a current (non-obsolete) FBbt cell term; FBbt has no adult-specific variant of it. The authors' typing is taken at face value.
